_comment: Task 4's second reply file. Layer it IN FRONT of replies.json:
It answers the call the first run of task 4 could not: a prompt whose
document is empty. `extract` reads bare `documents`, which is the `markdown`
kind (R3.11). The two PNGs the ZStandard page carries convert to
`page_images` (R8.10), so for them the step has no text at all -- and it is
still called, with `<source_document></source_document>` and nothing in it.
The rule matches exactly that, and answers as a careful model would: every
field null, with a reason. It cannot name the document, because nothing in
the prompt names one -- which is the whole problem. Task 4 is about why the
call happens, and SOLUTION.md about what it costs.
